python3 << 'EOF'
import math

# Data from table FD-1 (in millions of dollars)
# Public debt securities held by U.S. government (column 5)
govt = [1320784, 1447001, 1598459, 1765580, 1989072]

# Public debt securities held by the public (column 8)
public = [3653199, 3777810, 3814687, 3760613, 3667199]

# Calculate year-to-year log growth rates
# log growth rate = ln(value_t / value_{t-1})

def calc_log_growth_rates(data):
    growth_rates = []
    for i in range(1, len(data)):
        rate = math.log(data[i] / data[i-1])
        growth_rates.append(rate)
    return growth_rates

govt_growth = calc_log_growth_rates(govt)
public_growth = calc_log_growth_rates(public)

print("Year-to-year log growth rates:")
print("Government held:", govt_growth)
print("Public held:", public_growth)

# Calculate population standard deviation and mean for each
def calc_pop_std(values):
    n = len(values)
    mean = sum(values) / n
    variance = sum((x - mean) ** 2 for x in values) / n
    return math.sqrt(variance), mean

govt_std, govt_mean = calc_pop_std(govt_growth)
public_std, public_mean = calc_pop_std(public_growth)

print("\nPopulation stats:")
print(f"Government - std: {govt_std}, mean: {govt_mean}")
print(f"Public - std: {public_std}, mean: {public_mean}")

# Coefficient of variation = std dev / mean
govt_cv = govt_std / govt_mean
public_cv = public_std / public_mean

print("\nCoefficient of variation (DSI):")
print(f"Government: {govt_cv}")
print(f"Public: {public_cv}")

# Absolute difference
diff = abs(govt_cv - public_cv)
print(f"\nAbsolute difference: {diff}")
print(f"Rounded to thousandth: {round(diff, 3)}")
EOF
